India Women's Cricket Tour to South Africa Expanded

The India women's national cricket team's tour of South Africa has been expanded to include three additional T20 International matches. This expansion means the team will play a more comprehensive, multi-format series in South Africa. The details of the expanded schedule were confirmed, increasing the number of matches in the tour.
